title: Mulled Wine In Minutes!
summary: A cold snap in the Highlands sends Alana back to the firepit. She tries Mulled Beverages’ spice bags two ways: a saucepan for a few glasses, or a mug in the microwave for one. This was a paid collaboration.

title: Partnership with Byrne Vineyards
summary: Two very different Riverland bottles share a Flavabom label. Alana tastes the 2022 Field White, then puts the Fresh Pick Shiraz on the table with slow-braised beans and sourdough. The original partnership includes the recipe and its 2023 offer.

title: Wine Chats: Tony Allen
summary: What does sustainability actually look like in a winery? Rewild winemaker Tony Allen talks about making wine in the Southern Murray Darling, the work behind the label and the bottles that keep him curious.

title: I was asked to consult on a film...
summary: A restaurant scene needed a convincing exchange between a diner and a sommelier. With a menu and a screenplay to work from, Alana had to choose a wine that made sense both on the table and in the dialogue.

title: Cocktails with Bormioli
summary: A gift of Luigi Bormioli glassware inspired two drinks: the Old Cuban Fizzball and a Limonberry Spritz. The second starts well before cocktail hour, with homemade limoncello.

title: Sip & Eat: Chardy & Fish Curry
summary: A fish curry and a Victorian chardonnay are the starting point for this Sip & Eat dinner. Alana puts the recipe, the bottle and the music together so you can try the pairing at home.

title: Weekender's Guide to Mudgee
summary: The road from Sydney takes in Rylstone, De Beaurepaire and Baker Williams before a night at Roth’s. The weekend continues through Lowe, Cellar by Gilbert, Di Lusso, Moothi and Logan, with tasting picks along the way.

title: Sip & Eat: Sangiovese & "Moussaka"
summary: A bottle of sangiovese meets a home-cooked take on moussaka. The original kitchen notes lay out the ingredients and method, followed by a tasting and a soundtrack for dinner.

title: Excuse me postman, can I have my Mal-bec please?
summary: April 17 puts malbec in the spotlight. This introduction follows the grape from its French names and origins to the glass, with ideas for what to eat and listen to alongside it.

title: Rosenvale Barossa Grenache
summary: A Barossa grenache puts Rosenvale’s vineyards at the centre of this tasting. Alana looks at the people behind the bottle before choosing its food, soundtrack and occasion.

title: Bloody Good Wine
summary: Rosé, pinot and bubbles share the tasting table in this look at Tipsy Aunt Flo. Alana matches each wine to food, music and an occasion, and explores the producer’s support for menstrual equity.

title: Wine Chats: David Lowe
summary: At his Mudgee cellar door, winemaker David Lowe talks about the bottles that first caught his attention, what still surprises him and the wine he would take to a desert island.

title: F*cking Good Port
summary: After trying Riversands’ bubbles, Alana returns to the Queensland producer for a fortified wine with a particularly memorable name. Her tasting includes a suggested meal, mood and playlist pairing.

title: Wine for a Cause
summary: What can a bottle purchase support? Alana follows the projects behind Tipsy Aunt Flo, Little Giant, Tread Softly, The Hidden Sea and Little Ripples, from wombat welfare to clean water.

title: Why do we say 'Cheers'?
summary: From santé and salud to kanpai and skål, a shared toast has plenty of local expressions. Alana follows the words and customs behind raising a glass.

title: Riversands Wines
summary: Two sparkling wines introduce Riversands, a Queensland winery whose labels tell stories about the district. Alana opens the gifted bottles and pairs each with a dish, a song and a reason to celebrate.

title: To decant, or not to decant?
summary: A decanter can do two jobs: leave sediment behind and give a wine more contact with air. This guide explains when each matters and how to choose a vessel for the bottle you have.

title: Southern Highlands Top 6
summary: A cellar-door trail close to home: Artemis, Mount Ashby, Tertini, Eling Forest, Cuttaway Hill and Cherry Tree Hill. Alana shares the stops and bottles that shaped her original Southern Highlands shortlist.

title: Nothing says Celebration like Bubbles!
summary: Champagne, crémant, cava and prosecco all fizz, but they get there by different routes. Alana follows the traditional, transfer and tank methods from fermentation to finished bottle.

title: Wine Chats: Amanda Yallop
summary: Amanda Yallop, group wine director at Fink, talks about restaurant wine lists, the pleasure of unexpected matches, the bottles open in her kitchen and where she would travel for a glass.

title: Favourite Pinks for Spring
summary: Cockfighter’s Ghost, Audrey Wilkinson, Miles From Nowhere, Artemis, Bird in Hand and AIX make up this spring rosé selection, spanning local favourites and a French pour.

title: It's A Revolution...
summary: The colour of a rosé is only one clue to what is in the glass. This early Wine Wench feature explores the style behind one of Alana’s favourite pours.

title: Wine Shows - What?
summary: Behind the medals are blind flights, judging panels and a lot of tasting. This guide follows the show process through to trophies, with a look at the Jimmy Watson award.

title: Understanding Medals
summary: Gold, silver, bronze, double gold and trophies can share the same crowded bottle label. Alana unpacks the scoring bands and what the different awards tell a shopper.

title: Food Pairing like a Pro
summary: Taste the dish and the wine together. Sweetness, salt, acidity and bitterness change the way each comes across, and matching similar flavours gives a different result from choosing a contrast.

title: Wine Tasting like a Pro
summary: Start with the colour, give the glass a swirl, then smell before tasting. Alana breaks the sip down into acidity, sweetness, alcohol and tannin so you can put words to what you notice.
